account.name: Sephora
account.context: Premium acquisition relaunch before September. Data is ready. Budget is not signed.

transcript: Sephora meeting — July 9. Present: Claire Fontaine (Digital Director, Sephora), Julien Reyes (CRM Manager, Sephora), and Alex on our side. Claire: "We want to relaunch acquisition on the premium segment before back-to-school season." Julien: "Technically we're ready on the data side, but any budget decision goes through Marc, our Head of Sales — he makes the call." Alex: "I'll send you a proposal this week." Claire: "Perfect, put Marc in copy, we need his go." Open commitments: send the proposal, loop in Marc. Sales angle: premium budget validation before September, decision-maker = Marc (Head of Sales), not present in the meeting.

email.subject: Sephora premium proposal — your go, Marc?
email.body:
Hi Marc,

Welcome to Sephora — I saw you just took over as Head of Sales. Congratulations.

I spoke with Claire and Julien yesterday about relaunching premium acquisition before September. On the data side, Julien's team is ready; the only missing piece is your budget call.

I'm attaching the proposal. 15 minutes this week to lock in the go?

Best,
Alex

risk.text: Your champion, Léa Martin (VP Growth), left Back Market 6 days ago.
risk.why: No active sponsor inside the account and a renewal is 40 days out — this is how silent churn starts.
risk.action: Re-anchor now: ask Léa for a warm intro to her successor and get a second contact before renewal hits the danger zone.
